occupation.value: Attorney; pro tempore judge, Las Vegas Justice Court

citations.quote: Attorney and judge Shannon Nordstrom is up against Luke McCarthy, a veteran firefighter.
Nordstrom is currently a pro tempore judge with the Las Vegas Justice Court.
I offer a proven commitment to service as a mother, wife, attorney, caregiver, educator, Scout leader and dedicated community volunteer.

From October 2018 until October 2023, Shannon Nordstrom served the community as an appointed Hearing Commissioner and Alternate Judge with the Las Vegas Municipal Court. During that time, in 2022, she also served a 5-month appointment as Interim Municipal Court Judge in Department 6.

Shannon Nordstrom, who is also seeking the seat, has served as an alternate judge in Municipal Court, a temporary judge in Las Vegas Justice Court, where she heard small claims, and was appointed by the City Council to serve as an interim Municipal Court judge.
Both candidates are registered as Republicans and spoke to the Nevada Current about economic development, housing, homeless services, education, and data centers.
